| **Gustine Mayor Pat Nagy Endorses
John Duarte for Congress**** **
---
| | **Modesto, CA – **Today, Gustine Mayor Patrick "Pat" Nagy endorses John Duarte for Congress in Congressional District 13. Mayor Nagy was first appointed to the Gustine City Council in 2009 and was elected Mayor in 2018. Mayor Nagy serves on the Board of Directors of the Merced County Association of Governments, and on the Board of Directors of the San Joaquin Valley Regional Policy Committee.

“Since being elected to Congress, John has dedicated his time and resources to lifting up the residents of Gustine. Whether it’s servicing the community or addressing the Valley’s toughest challenges, John consistently puts the interests of working families first. I’ve had the privilege of working alongside John, have seen his commitment to Gustine, and proudly endorse his campaign for Congress,” said Mayor Nagy.

"I am thankful Mayor Pat Nagy has endorsed our campaign and shares our vision for a brighter future for working families. I look forward to continuing to work with Mayor Nagy on the tough issues affecting the residents of Gustine," said John Duarte.

Mayor Nagy’s endorsement highlights the growing support Duarte's re-election has received districtwide. In Washington, John Duarte remains committed to representing Gustine and Central Valley residents, fighting to lower unaffordable living costs, repealing tax hikes, and safeguarding our local neighborhoods from rising crime.

Please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=6619973a3a&e=76a47b375f) for more information about the campaign. ###

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

body:
Ensuring a More Lead-Free NYC | | | | [ ](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=9a338e35a2&e=2de202398d)

| Peter --

As you may have seen, [my bill](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=da227f21b5&e=2de202398d) to make lead paint-related hazards a more urgent violation passed in the City Council. This bill is written to protect families, especially children, from potential lead exposure.

This has been a priority of mine since I was elected to office, having seen first-hand as a housing organizer the dangerous construction and maintenance practices of some unscrupulous landlords. In fact, this latest bill follows other pro-tenant, lead- and construction-related protections I passed in my first term.

Just yesterday evening I stood with tenants on East 5th Street to hold their landlord accountable and ensure remediation of unsafe levels of lead dust in our homes. We were joined by neighbors, advocates and the Lead Dust Free NYC Coalition to show unity and collectively demand dignified housing opportunities for every New Yorker. When you mark my name on Election Day, you will be voting for someone who is working day and night to continue results-driven advocacy for tenants and families.

Thank you,

Carlina

clean_body: Ensuring a More Lead-Free NYC | | | | | Peter -- As you may have seen, to make lead paint-related hazards a more urgent violation passed in the City Council. This bill is written to protect families, especially children, from potential lead exposure. This has been a priority of mine since I was elected to office, having seen first-hand as a housing organizer the dangerous construction and maintenance practices of some unscrupulous landlords. In fact, this latest bill follows other pro-tenant, lead- and construction-related protections I passed in my first term. Just yesterday evening I stood with tenants on East 5th Street to hold their landlord accountable and ensure remediation of unsafe levels of lead dust in our homes. We were joined by neighbors, advocates and the Lead Dust Free NYC Coalition to show unity and collectively demand dignified housing opportunities for every New Yorker. When you mark my name on Election Day, you will be voting for someone who is working day and night to continue results-driven advocacy for tenants and families. Fellow American - I know God is not done with America yet.

It’s no secret that I am a steadfast Christian and man of God.

Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God and that our rights derive from Him and not the government.

The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: a special request for you
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

These wonderful people are never going to be the focal point of the media’s story.

But if the pro-life movement manages to **_STOP_** Ohio’s radical pro-abortion _Issue 1_ referendum and reclaim Virginia for the pro-life movement next Tuesday (November 7th), _our canvassers’ work – _all made possible by the generosity of good folks like you_ – will be a BIG PART of the reason why_.

Traveling non-stop across these states, canvassing, engaging with voters, having conversations, leading text messaging, phone banks, and media campaigns, and registering pro-life voters are all just some of the hard work they do.

Each and every one of them has bruised knuckles from knocking on doors, blisters from walking neighborhoods, and stories of interactions with angry pro-abortion radicals they’ve run into.

But they’re doing it all because saving lives is worth it, Pro-Life Friend. And they know what happens in Ohio and Virginia will have HUGE ramifications nationwide for 2024.

**[So, with time running out, can you please consider sending a PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE to one of our canvassers to encourage them as the battle for life heats up during this final week](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, it’s so crucial that we support our volunteer canvassers the best we can.

Putting in late nights of driving or making calls, having doors slammed in their face, and even being harassed and attacked by pro-abortion radicals are all things they deal with – _and they do it willingly._

If I could have it my way, I would just snap my fingers and have the Abortion Lobby drop the ball in every single election – _or, even better, just stand down and let the pro-life movement win every election._

That way our canvassers wouldn’t have to deal with all the stressful things election season brings . . .

But I’m not a magician. I don’t have any magical power – and the Abortion Lobby isn’t going down without a fight.

That’s why sending a PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE to one of our volunteer canvassers would mean the world to them!

A **[_one-time Care Package Gift of $100_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-j/)** can provide door-knocking materials like _Students for Life Action_ shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more!

A **[_one-time Care Package Gift of $65_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-i/)** can pay for a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations across Ohio and Virginia _(although this may only cover a few trips at the rate gas prices are increasing under President Biden)._

And a **[_Care package Gift of just $25_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-d/)** will provide a canvasser a day’s worth of meals while they spend their time volunteering for us.

Or if you’d like to provide one canvasser with all the materials, gas, and meals they’ll need for the next week until election day on November 7th, **[_a generous PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE Gift of $470 would accomplish that_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-h/)!**

It’s clear the Abortion Lobby thinks they already have 2024 in the bag.

And they certainly don’t hide the fact that it’s the tainted millions they make from their bloody “business” that makes them so certain – _not to mention the $600+ million in tax-payer funding they rake in every year._

Things might look grim for the pro-life movement from a financial perspective, but I know something the Abortion Lobby doesn’t.

We have a secret weapon that has **_PROVEN_** to defeat the Abortion Lobby time and again – _and I want to share our secret weapon with you. . ._

It’s you, Pro-Life Friend.

It’s you and countless other pro-lifers – _like our dedicated canvassers_ – who, through their time, talent, and treasure, help _Students for Life Action_ continue to exceed the Abortion Lobby in support!

Just look at what we did with _Roe v. Wade._

**_It’s sitting on the ash heap of history now_.**

And we couldn’t have done it without the decades of hard work from our volunteers – _all of whom are supported by the generosity of good folks like you._

**[So, please help our volunteer canvassers by sending one a generous PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE of $470, $100, $65, or $25 that will encourage them to keep fighting](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-k/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – In the hearts of Ohio and Virginia, _Students for Life Action_ has been on the front lines, waging a battle to protect the sanctity of Life.

They’re doing what they do because they want to see abortion abolished in their lifetime – _and that starts with winning in Ohio and Virginia!_

**[So, can you please consider sending a generous PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE to one of our canvassers to encourage them as the battle for life heats up in the coming weeks](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjttkkl-duchtdja-u/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Your America
subject: The decline of American Citizenship
body:
This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35987%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YSy5WuYYRMYY127uz4UHMA&sysid=1) Dear Friend,

My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College, where we offer free online courses to anyone who wishes to learn.

**One of our top-rated courses, “American Citizenship and Its Decline,” is taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson and is based on his book _The Dying Citizen_.**

This course argues that at the heart of America’s current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen.

Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people.

To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life.

Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups.

These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen.

Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today’s elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve.

The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government.

So, enroll today in this free course, “American Citizenship and Its Decline,” with Victor Davis Hanson. You can embark on this journey with us to learn about these threats to our rights as citizens and how to combat them.

Click the secure link below to start today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/american-citizenship-and-its-decline](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35988%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=evr00PZu7GSYs0S2j45vLg&sysid=1)
**

Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College |

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The Truth about America’s Christian heritage
body:
Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672940%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SV9ej7dQpztR5Fgy%2fN20zw&sysid=1)
---
Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672941%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5yTTOLBIHQNXegiAV9vGXg&sysid=1)
---
| | I would love for you to read this book and discover the truth about our nation’s Christian heritage. And as a token of our appreciation for a gift to Pathway to Victory, we’ll not only send you this book, but also a brand new CD featuring some of our nation’s most patriotic songs from First Baptist Dallas’ renowned choir and orchestra. [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-kit-2](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672942%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wi6WPzlLLVaumVODkt7b%2bA&sysid=1)

As believers, we must preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. By understanding our nation’s Christian roots, we can work to bring our country back to its founding principles. At the end of my book, I provide suggestions for how to do just that.

I hope you’ll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Gratefully,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zt6h2uva5dnhippchc3u9a3cl4eg7mubi9cn0838_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5c9h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4iao49voeu5u92tt31lvtbe6bkruu7p7038ilg0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5c9h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1uqoh1pq0a6ltc84d1jmfbtjok7q11tb5j85brg_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5c9h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____

name: Pro Life Update
subject: This is essential to preserve freedom
body:
The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp39vbdsvulk5c2ii0hpf1npmar56sb6rn6rmis0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs) Dear Friend of the Constitution, The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution—with a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you’re receiving Hillsdale College’s **Second Amendment Survey** because you’re someone who understands that education is essential to the defense of liberty. We are reaching and teaching millions of Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding. Could you take a few minutes to complete our **Second Amendment Survey** using the secure link below? [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z62kr0dh04bq5m91hqj4c4p1duigiqgt19mkr95g_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs "https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/")

## There is a coordinated effort underway to undermine the Constitution, including the Second Amendment.
[AGREE](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk4dppto3cms9mbple18d5o18r0hl5s720b1gkno_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs) [DISAGREE](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj00lphj2s9iv8uovk0vf4n0irop4lrhlhdb0es0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs) [NOT SURE](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zam0a3rh8uj90pob0b38ou9cv4c2slmv64a47g48_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs)
Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty—which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left’s most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is **ignorance**. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: “The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**.” This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where “safe spaces” are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here’s an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause “panic” among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. **But instead of just TALKING, it’s more important to DO something about it.** That’s why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That’s why I would like your answers to our brief **Second Amendment Survey.** You can complete the survey today at this secure link: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ze2p66iakn85sbdtsa6et5m4fkk3oln2vre1vda8_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs) We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.” Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It’s also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. **Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty—including the Second Amendment—for future generations.** After completing your **Second Amendment Survey** , please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed **Second Amendment Survey.** Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
**P.S.** Our Constitution—including the Second Amendment—is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our **Second Amendment Survey** at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdpn5p5p59a526k3th47alt192acfaclv8pl54co_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs)

name: American Action News
subject: Free Course! Rediscover the essence of American Citizenship
body:
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp2oehuid8590j059sk60mkdo1h5idrmq4jjltdo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs) Dear Friend,

My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College, where we offer free online courses to anyone who wishes to learn.

**One of our top-rated courses, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," is taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson and is based on his book _The Dying Citizen_.**

This course argues that at the heart of America's current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen.

Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people.

To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life.

Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups.

These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen.

Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today's elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve.

The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government.

So, enroll today in this free course, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," with Victor Davis Hanson. You can embark on this journey with us to learn about these threats to our rights as citizens and how to combat them.

Click the secure link below to start today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/american-citizenship-and-its-decline](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqlc2c8une6ltlenrrq4npj03q5v649df6j67lao_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g6aor5chh2bs)
**

Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College |

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms
body:
Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35995%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=abTFKVp6%2bKCWujqgrpSBug&sysid=1)
---
Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35996%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sTGVaMp8%2bUcSMyvpwH0dxA&sysid=1)
---
| | I would love for you to read this book and discover the truth about our nation’s Christian heritage. And as a token of our appreciation for a gift to Pathway to Victory, we’ll not only send you this book, but also a brand new CD featuring some of our nation’s most patriotic songs from First Baptist Dallas’ renowned choir and orchestra. [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-kit-2](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35997%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gm50XjhNm85jwYduyBls0w&sysid=1)

As believers, we must preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. By understanding our nation’s Christian roots, we can work to bring our country back to its founding principles. At the end of my book, I provide suggestions for how to do just that.

I hope you’ll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Gratefully,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The truth is, no one knows for certain
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0nuemaupbnngmb5mqm7gamfmlmtlkgjdoon73m0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g69oj4clh2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9idlb4e3hu8hu664p5fe173cffnsh5pkpcrkaqo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g69oj4clh2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbrv9tg1kd9au8vns8qjj2j24doav8ui1rqsn5g0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1g69oj4clh2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ. When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence. As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King. In my brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into: 1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist? 2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event? 3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture? 4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance? 5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem? Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure. In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative. would like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to Victory. Make your generous gift here: Pathway to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support. May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus. Daylight savings ends this Sunday morning at 2 a.m., as Americans “fall back” for an extra hour of sleep. But despite legislative efforts to change the practice, we’ll still spring forward again next March.

| | | [](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJydjrGOwjAQRL8m7ojWXjsJhYu7gg4aCkrLZ6-JwYlRYpD4eyykk664CmnKN2-GNO_6YeilBGBeByJByKIWIBCQK9hKxWUbgiOUCnvkCEPnGwnkY8lLe8lxLiOF9MwPWlqXJzbqoJzlFVaD66UCua12UATBehS8-2FJj6Xc1ga_GrGr-cdy2pu9jSnO54OdSJeQzW3JqwHccLURaI42FbMSeUNTBfNsXfSVITeSuxrOFn25XyklOzXi21Ow91Tq8V-i_VN7L5YPRl71WWnS)

# FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 3, 2023
---|---
**Good morning!** On this date in 1956, CBS broadcast the first major Hollywood film to be shown in its entirety on TV: "The Wizard of Oz," which became an annual fall TV event until 1991. ([See Photos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GOhCAQgOGnwY4NDIhSUFxjt9deaVSGdS7obJC4cZ_-cldf_yd_vq_7eJ8o0_74nDYMNfE4LZVOHLWWRoIZbRNDQgQ0DQbtvFe69b1v1qANdM60DtvOqd73tje9U7OZMcXZd6qhAAqM1soo31rrbnEBnDu7RAT0ywzCKoxUudy-mfa6YsoXn1huC29NDmutz0OYDwGDgOFRmM9rpaNyuX4LAYP2rZMvek8lSk6S3_JY-bXLxEUmKkeVlTaUvMt6ChigKSE-X5QzHa4TVj22ifLfrf5r_wkAAP__VNFa4Q)) If you haven't signed up for _The Flyover_ yet, you can take care of that [with one click](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu8yAQAOCngS0R3J1xGBh-KfL0p2tHi8BhX4vtyKGp-vZV1bHZv-l7vYyXKFXW6SUuHFrZxpiaPHi09oAHwJF0DoUZGDUH67w3tvMnr-dgkV3GAuWUutih9ZmAvO2pGNdbS1oCGEBrDRrfEbljTsDXnlJmYJ-uoMhwlrbtx7dN1jZzqV_bg_dj2hZdw9za7a7wn4JBwfCXKBgucZL0X9b3H4MDKzzn26fUKnfXKzLTEqX-WvfRFoVnMnoPz41uTwO-AwAA___XLlsF). _The Flyover _is a small business trying to fill a big void in the media landscape. ## Daylight Savings Time Ends, Again
Daylight savings [ends this Sunday morning at 2 a.m](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAQRL_GZKB228A4cHCJs7n0QmTsHuiTwSPsG8Tfn1htuFG94ElVqj_P6ek58b789hvZ-sqTD5U_NEnZqhbVpJtoX0RIqiErB2NA9uZhmtXGfpRzbx5BPwjJAwyq96BgGOQclQkNWwRUUoIC02s9dDEgzaMOkZBMmFFooMg1H93fzHtd6ZWu_KGjC3lrkl1rfRehfgl0At15nt2_4muO_roFga7UfFwC3U5nucNXzrtAd9cKdBJu7gU6Lm30V-JlrW3xH96XtvJGLe3x5m9_lGiMNApgFOiaw8b3ySlxGUahYdk8p69l9cef_gcAAP__UZ9lwQ)., as Americans "fall back" for an extra hour of sleep. But despite legislative efforts to change the practice, we'll still spring forward again next March. The Senate unanimously approved the Sunshine Protection Act last year, a bill that would make daylight savings time permanent. But it [stalled there,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAUhJ8Gd1hwwD8UFLdxt7dNaWE4tk-EYWXIOvv2kVOnmWZG80nfx2N-OIqUtv_uQFvXPDtf6YWzlFxxULNugl0RAVWDVvbGCNmZ0TS77YJ2AhysS-jHoDs9GA3jIkZUYhg7aMiCACWlUMJ0Wvdt8IDLoH1AQOMXYFpgoJrP9jNTqjuu8Z1feLY-H020e63PwtQ_BhOD6bqu1n1TLnfLYLq_GUxSMpjEHcG9I2175cW9KG2FVzqQ-92lDfm95uUrlZ0S8ueZK_pKOTWnDc-LYqTSD0yL7XAUf_n1Txs_AQAA__9sz1_i) and a 2023 version remains stuck in committee. In the 1970s, Congress made daylight savings time permanent but reversed themselves less than a year later after early-morning darkness proved dangerous for school children, still one of the biggest obstacles to change.

body:
This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dac4752e20eb4431bae0b0bf0e6f7656&_e=BUNqlJIr13_Il-XWD8hz6LdiCliQ4l4W1AGp8PgFrlhWx3gfsEji4FR-I3lnGMbrVcFuFf5iLvYB30E8NQVisaNyDJpbMqFgPNMOFU1YqRSV1bEVSf0k5uHa1Nkp6gGBxSG_ZMquKf88vz7RBkegLlEaG1USgZ1dymWs5pRPGBDR5PL22W6q5eBPd7WgJWJf5Si-BkahIejO2xxwYRD7TUqZaVGZAlqmm3mDYBUzOUqXbY2vMYbnFWP9yFhhENm9ZFMxcbh2OY11fwKVqn8Mdgcze6qKxWd_ssP3KO9NK0uMuHEC1l__1G7514ikrORdOX-svHyaT9NCyGJNnB8GckkJXDOjOpyGSMEVqx_yOf0EEcEj-sBzmcHkI7qiOTcNkL3hpN_nmjaFukJnTzFYiiPb0ZlcjPIuVleEywoo5MOMXis5J57mNNedyzBdjXYB) Dear Friend,

My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College, where we offer free online courses to anyone who wishes to learn.

**One of our top-rated courses, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," is taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson and is based on his book _The Dying Citizen_.**

This course argues that at the heart of America's current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen.

Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people.

To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life.

Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups.

These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen.

Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today's elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve.

The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government.

This course argues that at the heart of America's current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen. Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people. To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life. Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups. These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen. Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today's elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve. The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I've written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you'll appreciate.

My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College, where we offer free online courses to anyone who wishes to learn.

**One of our top-rated courses, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," is taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson and is based on his book _The Dying Citizen_.**

This course argues that at the heart of America's current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen.

Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people.

To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life.

Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups.

These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen.

Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today's elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve.

The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government.

So, enroll today in this free course, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," with Victor Davis Hanson. You can embark on this journey with us to learn about these threats to our rights as citizens and how to combat them.

Click the secure link below to start today.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The Truth about America’s Christian heritage
body:
Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f0c55c07ae1440f4873afe72ba09b045&_e=JBnheQGwibaWQnSfpamHUzkkw7b1tNkTyjcb6S68SsItQ90yGeqpj52sdr1orQ-lqG6W2KrUpHC51xsbPzx5rIANJYJ31OnSz-jKKHkT8peVygSSqNwNu8cnsLtvJPBO2m79c9uhBV20doXaiFuYV9nnC-wAYSUtoB2I8plyxNz1qouMOUvIHdWBv0wdETTRCjQNFhjPNO00bKYMlE7nAR4BVZy7LlgJaJHzWbz10Mn0-MgD1Zc_GsURefCmZKGwRRtMF4SM0-CGPXhYP73U7B2iCzPHHuwSsCJyZS8eUDQ42tsDuy8CmVdk0E7SCPeHdtSo6fXH1eA_8-E6UN6-0QcLF2b98kzhgbUK3kEVsgSmwE4_qEAZvhcsC-PCMCV9OfndLhtkK10zXX5DpFL2IQvrS5WIgLwZTfnrAE82xiU%3D)

Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I've written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you'll appreciate.
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f0c55c07ae1440f4873afe72ba09b045&_e=JBnheQGwibaWQnSfpamHUzkkw7b1tNkTyjcb6S68SsItQ90yGeqpj52sdr1orQ-lqG6W2KrUpHC51xsbPzx5rIANJYJ31OnSz-jKKHkT8peVygSSqNwNu8cnsLtvJPBO2m79c9uhBV20doXaiFuYVy4trGPMo7IJsbhpi6UkUM58BoJtECw9I10q32s_ueI0FriostJRpyYLsF_i6I65WGS94ucC94RyjhIZyKYkBbeacM5CUeETTVbmO5Qj-sviit8bugu7L9KAukAsAtI8GafgMpGGwb4iZHFh-MFoA-7i2XPa9PUvwn7rqGRAGpqYF8oudbudFbapWTl2uHinTafGJRqrjxc0l2vHThJ8m3czSjrawcXnVzpnjjs995aiGzLVy7OQcBrkhvlKaqKmCBi1BmRWENdRUAIIvjt2nyw%3D)

And as a token of our appreciation for a gift to Pathway to Victory, we'll not only send you this book, but also a brand new CD featuring some of our nation's most patriotic songs from First Baptist Dallas' renowned choir and orchestra. [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-kit-2](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f0c55c07ae1440f4873afe72ba09b045&_e=JBnheQGwibaWQnSfpamHUzkkw7b1tNkTyjcb6S68SsItQ90yGeqpj52sdr1orQ-lqG6W2KrUpHC51xsbPzx5rIANJYJ31OnSz-jKKHkT8peVygSSqNwNu8cnsLtvJPBO2m79c9uhBV20doXaiFuYVy4trGPMo7IJsbhpi6UkUM58BoJtECw9I10q32s_ueI0FriostJRpyYLsF_i6I65WGS94ucC94RyjhIZyKYkBbeacM5CUeETTVbmO5Qj-sviit8bugu7L9KAukAsAtI8GQYEZt6NLoV-R35jpjSf6zWPb2MKf2TDodmZpQpfKuHTTvNlnIO7pSwFDGuNqfLUz3ccYRjPQLwNW8hKwvkq_5v7Gt5TxSiXCsu1FHTdguKlPffoIgD5tZ8uuJpX_C8-aiDTMI5i2QG_56nDbGpPlp4%3D)

As believers, we must preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. By understanding our nation's Christian roots, we can work to bring our country back to its founding principles. At the end of my book, I provide suggestions for how to do just that.

I hope you'll consider donating to _Pathway to Victory_ and receiving your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ so you can know without a doubt that the foundation of our country was solidly established in the principles of the Bible.

Gratefully,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

Dear
Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

You can
get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/.

And
please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's
important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them
to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can

Thanks,
Greg

subject: The Truth about America’s Christian heritage
body:
Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=396e7f85cbdd4377965aca9048000dfc&_e=6EPvnfNndH3ALxp9vhvKMZVKzu_9JDWnZvU-pUElIs-siauHEeK4cX0hPXF-gZs-1MReGfKo6_YOzs-qeDOCJ9StAYo-IL0_YgO49rbAIJ-9799AMggCU5bvh0kjifj75V9YVeNGP206wpyiv0f-AtjHPHyH-xJYG4DnUWN8PgDYXXaX5eS2hKI1ajI6qGYuoupUIy8Pl280SC0Zb2r8jbg9GgsFF8fxB4MK1_JXUUexCsc-MWPIvLfzUiz1-S5h3VTKANvsCOibcruep3cIdCgexsRN61LSh7Y4p2c0RVSVhZkqY7VfE3DtKJPHXbe215PV3zwAh1oR3pK_V8KGxWfOwWMjoPd1ImX3Itjby2wex9-j5yVmMq7MNkhxM8_ie7pZG39PvLfjV_q7np-y8s_k2ZXXqTCgVWv9jQlI7kw%3D)

Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I've written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you'll appreciate.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**." This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student body. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. | | | **For years, platforms like Meta’s Instagram have knowingly sucked kids into addictive and compulsive social media use —** prioritizing profits over the well-documented, real-world harms their products have created for kids. Finally, a massive group of state attorney generals is suing to correct this problem – but they’re already facing well-funded pressure from Big Tech to drop the lawsuit. [**Co-sign a letter of support to these courageous state attorneys general to tell them – we’ve got your back!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38d5e1a9-8365-44e4-bf73-4cc9013c1ec9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Peter, If you’ve recently spent any time around teenagers, it’s clear that we have a widespread addiction problem on our hands. **Kids are hooked on social media** – and sometimes, it can have devastating consequences. Researchers have been looking at this problem for years, of course, and found convincing evidence that heavy social media use tends to make teenagers – especially girls – feel worse about their bodies and creates anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts. But what’s even more shocking is that Meta (the parent company of Facebook and Instagram) has known about this problem for years, according to documents leaked by an internal whistleblower in 2021 [1] – **and they’ve apparently chosen to do virtually nothing about it since then.** **Finally, officials are stepping up to take action:** a group of 41 states and Washington, DC are now suing Meta to hold the company accountable for the youth mental health crisis caused by the addictive nature of Facebook and Instagram’s platforms. [2] Here at Accountable Tech, we couldn’t agree more. [**That’s why we’re asking you today to co-sign our letter of support to these attorneys general to let them know we approve of – and appreciate – their bold action.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38d14854-e61b-492d-9ef5-765af3f4b177/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | Accountable Tech sounded the alarm on this issue for years. We launched [Stop Instagram for Kids](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te29aee5b-7ba1-45bd-ac79-0ef02a811a56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), shining a light on the platform’s relentless focus on appearance, self-presentation, and branding, which presents challenges to adolescents’ privacy and wellbeing. But thanks to grassroots support, we convinced Meta to stop developing a version of Instagram for children under the age of 13. Peter – we can take on Big Tech and win. We’ve done it before and now we need to support these attorneys general. Big Tech has massive lobbying power and cash to throw around. Meanwhile, kids struggle with deliberate design choices made by Big Tech that keep them addicted to social media and online platforms. **[Add your name to our letter of support to these attorneys general to let them know we approve of their bold action.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5f0e3d8d-450b-4f42-8b3f-1530ededa70f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

Finally, a massive group of state attorney generals is suing to correct this problem – but they’re already facing well-funded pressure from Big Tech to drop the lawsuit. | Peter, If you’ve recently spent any time around teenagers, it’s clear that we have a widespread addiction problem on our hands. Kids are hooked on social media – and sometimes, it can have devastating consequences. Researchers have been looking at this problem for years, of course, and found convincing evidence that heavy social media use tends to make teenagers – especially girls – feel worse about their bodies and creates anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts. But what’s even more shocking is that Meta (the parent company of Facebook and Instagram) has known about this problem for years, according to documents leaked by an internal whistleblower in 2021 [1] – and they’ve apparently chosen to do virtually nothing about it since then. Finally, officials are stepping up to take action: a group of 41 states and Washington, DC are now suing Meta to hold the company accountable for the youth mental health crisis caused by the addictive nature of Facebook and Instagram’s platforms. [2] Here at Accountable Tech, we couldn’t agree more. | | | | | | | | Accountable Tech sounded the alarm on this issue for years. We launched , shining a light on the platform’s relentless focus on appearance, self-presentation, and branding, which presents challenges to adolescents’ privacy and wellbeing. But thanks to grassroots support, we convinced Meta to stop developing a version of Instagram for children under the age of 13. Peter – we can take on Big Tech and win. We’ve done it before and now we need to support these attorneys general. Big Tech has massive lobbying power and cash to throw around. Meanwhile, kids struggle with deliberate design choices made by Big Tech that keep them addicted to social media and online platforms. | | | | | | | | | | Without accountability, Big Tech will continue to profit from kids' declining mental health. Let's ensure our children's future isn't compromised by the addictive grips of social media. body:
It’s imperative you read this as soon as you see it.

| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bVTcedHK8ECj5PqEz3FObQ&sysid=1) [

---
Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last week - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you - with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672080%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6iRkfCAa4zNBFIvV57SlLw&sysid=1) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672081%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4ruQ7Hh3eZgVjby7XeB95Q&sysid=1) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff have told me that we’re just short of having raised $1 million online since I was elected speaker last week. In fact, we have just another $134,000 to raise to hit that mark - and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672082%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gMmDIxPymJM0h08DU6WKug&sysid=1)

[** CHIP IN $12 **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672083%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7tUvOU4G6VYx2E0HXIHWAw&sysid=1) [** CHIP IN $25 **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672084%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zr3fBRO8O0iEmiIpA9skOA&sysid=1) [** CHIP IN $50 **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672095%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F6o5yPUtbBuhbRmzWXNiMQ&sysid=1)
[**Our ability to raise money from grassroots conservatives like you will send a signal to Democrats that we are ready to help reelect a Republican majority in next year’s midterms.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672096%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=q3Nv%2f8ME5CdLkyNfbpAnbQ&sysid=1)

If we come up short, all bets are off.

I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we’ve made toward hitting this critical campaign goal.

Let’s get this done.

For America,

[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672097%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tXzJQ2JtMbHOkUSQLVVqPA&sysid=1)

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

[** CHIP IN BEFORE MIDNIGHT **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672098%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SgFJP3PXt%2fQmo%2bjUhUVKFw&sysid=1)

| **_MIKE JOHNSON_**

Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House. My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last week - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS. In the past week, 1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes. 2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch. 3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. I’ve got to be honest with you - with so many competing priorities, I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol. You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election. If we come up short, all bets are off. I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we’ve made toward hitting this critical campaign goal. Let’s get this done. body:
It’s imperative you read this as soon as you see it.

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2ql18rr4v4vrq35cpo2uglntvctbgkg8imkes38_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1h69o34cdh2bs)

Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

In fact, we have just another $134,000 to raise to hit that mark – and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv7grtbis0ek5p3ndqb15ic4kt98b3g4v2a6dlmo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1h69o34cdh2bs)

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

| | Friend, Yesterday, we launched “Veterans for Kelly”, a coalition of over 100 members of New Hampshire's veteran community, led by Kelly's husband, retired Air Force LTC Joseph Daley. Launching the coalition Kelly said, “Coming from a military family, honoring our commitment to veterans is deeply personal to me. My Grandfather served in the Army Air Corps in World War II, my husband Joe was an A-10 pilot in the Air Force and our daughter Kate is following in her father’s footsteps as a cadet at the Air Force Academy. I understand the sacrifice that our service members and their families make every day." “I am so grateful to have the support and confidence of these men and women who have bravely served our nation. As Governor, I will ensure that every military family receives the benefits and respect they have earned.” Leading the coalition, retired Air Force LTC Joseph Daley said “Kelly understands the issues facing veterans and military families because she has lived it. Our family is proud to have served our country – and I am proud of Kelly’s work to support veterans and military families. We are blessed to a large veteran population in New Hampshire. I know that Kelly will work every day to make New Hampshire the most veteran friendly state in the nation.” Check out our Veterans Coalition below and be sure to follow our [Facebook Page](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/61OkF-fXG/c?w=ROfJi4HBRDNhnZR1ZXYn8S0J4uiFBs6LORY5Pfstnh8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL0tlbGx5QXlvdHRlRm9yTkgiLCJyIjoiZmM3MGMxYzktMWNjNy00ODNhLTlmMDYtYmI2NDg3ZmYxMjNiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMmIwOGU3MDMtYTYyNy00NmYzLWJlOGEtNWQ1NjU0NDI2MjAyIn0) for more updates along the trail. subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdb6trbk3h2lq8nogu3fs47bn22qqsup8664a730_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zms3gkgkunbe430uoksaju6ueom1ovdu6i098coo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjf9lv56m187cdeqbo3ddvcvl2ahqnckmdpi9lao_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z305rvc48h53q1s67qf4se0jufrq2m6kvi15f5p8_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5rfvv2v6a92inrnr8vtq1s9tk2rf41lcnr6u4no_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpbmfbo6edsglgvlf5h5onpkmn0btrsic40e11b8_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0ssuimof8nopd114s7om5u0seofasq0j852bjtg_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. ")**

****

But in order to get there, **[I need your help to make it across the finish line- starting right now.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpsnv180oltopia1bg1n7fcqj800ae1qjk1qcm70_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "I need your help â€“ starting right now. Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5266j8leb9mvv55kceajmrk410vh4fj03c71nng_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6kqmrnhle4s8j0og2t26eurs0ju002ppcpcvgpo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s1j60p70c9h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. Since the day I read Senator Menendez's corruption indictment, I knew I had to do something. Some people say that corruption is just par for the course in politics, but we don't have to accept that. I will never accept that.

Here's what's happened so far:

On Friday, September 22, Senator Menendez was charged with a three-count federal corruption indictment. He is accused of taking hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes, including gold bars.

I was the first leader from New Jersey to call for Senator Menendez to resign. I was soon joined by a host of leaders. By Saturday, nearly every major New Jersey leader had called for Senator Menendez to resign. Even so, Senator Menendez said, "I am not going anywhere."

On Saturday, after talking with my wife and my team, I decided to run for U.S. Senate because New Jerseyans deserve a public servant, not a corrupt, indicted politician.

The next week, POLITICO reported that if Mendendez runs, extremist Republicans would have their best shot at flipping the Senate seat in 52 years. A new poll showed that Senator Menendez would lose a general election, jeopardizing the Senate majority. That same poll showed that I would win.

The following week, explosive new indictment charges came out alleging that Senator Menendez was acting as an unregistered agent of a foreign government. Due to the serious nature of these charges, I feel the U.S. Senate should expel Senator Menendez.

Even after all this, Senator Menendez still refuses to resign.

That's six major developments so far, and we have the toughest months of the campaign ahead of us as we race toward the primary.
