disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
On November 7th, the United States Supreme Court will be hearing arguments regarding the Fifth Circuit’s decision in United States v. Rahimi
#

We’d like to let you know that the email below discusses domestic violence. If this is not something you’d like to read about today, please click away.
If you or someone you love is in danger, please know that you are not alone. There are resources available to you. Call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text “START” to 88788 to be connected with an advocate.
* * *
[](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_nov23/?source=em231103-1-30&refcode2=6782.3935704.EW07H3&akid=6782%2E3935704%2EEW07H3)
Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to reach out to you personally about a critical Supreme Court case being heard in less than two weeks from now.
On November 7th, the United States Supreme Court will be hearing oral argument in an appeal of the Fifth Circuit’s decision in _United States v. Rahimi_. Earlier this year the Fifth Circuit struck down the federal law that prohibits people subject to domestic violence restraining orders from possessing guns.
This reckless decision puts countless lives at risk, and it disproportionately impacts women. Every year, more than 600 American women are shot and killed by intimate partners. And millions more have been threatened with a gun.
[**Please, join me today in calling on the Supreme Court to reinstate the ban on domestic abusers owning guns by signing GIFFORDS’ petition.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_nov23/?source=em231103-1-30&refcode2=6782.3935704.EW07H3&akid=6782%2E3935704%2EEW07H3)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_nov23/?source=em231103-1-30&refcode2=6782.3935704.EW07H3&akid=6782%2E3935704%2EEW07H3)**
It is my greatest hope that the Supreme Court will make the right decision in this case and recognize that it is constitutional and commonsense to ban those subject to a domestic violence restraining order from owning firearms. That’s been the case for decades, and there’s no reason to go backwards now.
This case is the paramount opportunity to demonstrate that we care more about protecting women’s lives than letting domestic abusers have guns.
[**Countless lives are on the line. Will you please join me in calling on the Supreme Court to disarm domestic violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_rahimi_pet_nov23/?source=em231103-1-30&refcode2=6782.3935704.EW07H3&akid=6782%2E3935704%2EEW07H3)
Thank you for using your voice,
Gabby Giffords

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=6782%2E3935704%2EEW07H3) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Speaker Mike Johnson
subject: Their futures are at stake
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR
BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWYedppidN

Mike Johnson for Congress

When Kelly and I dreamed of our future, we certainly
didn't envision co-parenting with...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWYedppidN

Fellow American,

When people ask Kelly and me why
we keep going, and why we are still compelled to serve in public
office, no matter how difficult the days, our answer is simple:
"This is for our children. For ALL of our children and
grandchildren."

There is a very real question
right now whether they will be able to enjoy the same liberty,
security, and opportunity that we have. Freedom is imperiled
today and there is a crisis at every turn.

Kelly and I have four amazing
kids, and we give our all-every day-to try to ensure that we can
pass along the blessings of liberty to Hannah, Abby, Jack, and
Will, and everyone in the generation of Americans that follow us.
I am certain that you share that same conviction.

I believe that God is not done
with America yet.

I believe we need to unite as a
party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is
great - but I am bullish about the future of America.

I believe in the law - I'm a
constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

I believe America is the freest,
most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world
- but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are
numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda
on the rest of us.

Last November, the American
people put their faith in House Republicans and gave us a
majority. We've been charged with holding Democrats accountable
for their failure to get our country out of the malaise of their
own making. To deliver on the promises we made, we need you on
our team TODAY.

STAND WITH SPEAKER MIKE >

Fellow American, I know it takes
time to build trust; you're getting to know me and I'm navigating
this new role - but we must act - and quickly. We need a full
course correction, otherwise, I'm not sure what version of
America we'll hand down to the next generation.

So, I'm asking you today - please
commit to a donation of any amount. We will use your gift to help
defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for
freedom.

-STEP FORWARD TODAY-
DONATE >

I made a promise when I was first
elected to do what is best for our country, and I intend to keep
that promise. Stand with me today.

God bless,

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

MIKE JOHNSON
Mike is a dedicated
husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law
attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the
fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been
a priority to the people of Louisiana.

WILL YOU STAND WITH
MIKE?

PAID FOR
BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA

---
Peter Willis,It’s been another busy week on the campaign trail for the Barrett Brigade. We’ve begun circulating petitions to collect signatures, canvassed in South Lyon to help candidates running for local elections, and visited with the MSU College Republicans – and many stops in between! Every conversation I have centers around stopping Joe Biden’s disastrous policies, reviving our economy, and keeping families and our communities safe. What we are seeing in the Middle East, our southern border, and here at home has so many concerned, and they’re right to call for new leadership in Washington. This is why I’m running for Congress. We can’t afford to keep the status quo; there’s just too much at stake. If you agree and share my urgency for new leadership, I hope you’ll join my team today and help us win next November. It starts by helping me get on the ballot by collecting the required number of signatures from around the Seventh District. Can I count on you to assist in our efforts to secure ballot access?Thanks for your continued support.

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | _**Running Out of Time**_
---
Friends, Let’s make history! With your help, let’s try to break the record for the highest Republican turnout in municipal elections. We are heading into the final weekend for early voting for municipal elections. From now until Tuesday at 6 p.m., if you live in a municipality you have a chance to help us make sure Republicans turn out to vote in record numbers. Please make a plan to ["bank your vote"](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/113ae1798d700ce93947229f28c3afba/6d5802613e92e447c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and vote this weekend. Reach out to your friends, family, coworkers and others to make sure they go with you to vote for our Republican leaders who are poised to continue to deliver improved quality of life for our cities and towns across the state. If you are unable to vote early, please make sure you and all of those in your life have a plan to vote on election day. The polls in your city or town will be open from 6am-6pm on Tuesday, November, 7th. I am confident that with your help we can get more Republicans than ever before engaged in our extremely important municipal elections. If you need help finding your early vote or election day voting location, please visit [https://indianavoters.in.gov/](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/113ae1798d700ce93947229f28c3afba/83634b1f018efd66c3d6b838967d376c/40313). Remember, your municipal leaders are the government closest to you and have the greatest impact on your lives. Please be sure to get out and vote for your Republican team!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Thank you.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
I understand that these goals are not the most important thing in the world. But it is important that we reach them, and it's especially important that we do it together.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=680%2E791427%2EXk2kY5)

Friend,
We wanted to give your inbox a breather for a couple days, but I felt it was important to reach out this morning and express my gratitude to you for being a part of this team.
It was not an easy October. Not for our movement, not for those who we stand with in the fight for justice across the globe.
Through all of it, I have been heartened to see endless messages of support and shows of solidarity from people nationwide, which have strengthened my resolve to work for a more equitable, just, and peaceful world.
Now, I know our team reached out a lot over the past week, mostly through emails like this one.
That's why I also wanted to share that thanks to the incredible support of lots and lots of people like you, we reached our grassroots fundraising goals for the month.
I understand that these goals are not the most important thing in the world. But it is important that we reach them, and it's especially important that we do it together.
So long as we do that, we can build the kind of campaign required to take on the right wing and their super PACs, win, and continue our fight.
Sincerely, thank you. For your support, for being a part of this team, and for everything you do. It means more than I can say to know that we can count on each other when it matters most.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: Rise and shine!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ZAK FOR CONGRESS
body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-rosen-split?amount=20?source=em231103-zm-jr-split&refcode2=561_8507_vV20oD&akid=561%2E8507%2EvV20oD)

Rise and shine, folks!

I’m up early sipping a cup of coffee, and it has me thinking back to some of the jobs I had long before I was elected to the U.S. Senate. When I was a waitress in college, I used to wake up at the crack of dawn to work the breakfast shift.

**Breakfast is the hardest shift as a waitress because of two things: toast and coffee.** You have to time the toast so it comes out with the breakfast – and you have to do that while also making sure everybody in the restaurant has enough coffee. Think that’s easy? _Forget about it._

When I think about toast and coffee nowadays, it reminds me of where I came from and why I fight so hard for working families to this day.

Growing up, I worked a lot of different jobs – folding laundry at the dry cleaners, scooping ice cream, working in a research lab. I worked as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace on the Las Vegas Strip and was a member of Culinary Workers Union Local 226. I did it all to make ends meet and become the first in my family to graduate college. Even after I started my career as a computer programmer, I took community college classes at night to get ahead and worked as a banquet waitress on the weekends to pay my bills.

Today, my job is serving Nevada in the U.S. Senate, and it is the honor of my life. And I’m especially proud to represent the union members and hardworking families who built our great state.

**I will always remember my roots. That’s why I never let up in the fight to grow our middle class, create good-paying jobs, and lower everyday costs. But to keep up that fight, I need your help right now.**

_CNN_ is reporting that I'm one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection, and recent polling shows me 2 points down in the race that experts predict is likely to decide Senate control. The only way I can keep Nevada blue is with your support.

clean_body: Rise and shine, folks! I’m up early sipping a cup of coffee, and it has me thinking back to some of the jobs I had long before I was elected to the U.S. Senate. When I was a waitress in college, I used to wake up at the crack of dawn to work the breakfast shift. Breakfast is the hardest shift as a waitress because of two things: toast and coffee. You have to time the toast so it comes out with the breakfast – and you have to do that while also making sure everybody in the restaurant has enough coffee. Think that’s easy? Forget about it. When I think about toast and coffee nowadays, it reminds me of where I came from and why I fight so hard for working families to this day. Growing up, I worked a lot of different jobs – folding laundry at the dry cleaners, scooping ice cream, working in a research lab. I worked as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace on the Las Vegas Strip and was a member of Culinary Workers Union Local 226. I did it all to make ends meet and become the first in my family to graduate college. Even after I started my career as a computer programmer, I took community college classes at night to get ahead and worked as a banquet waitress on the weekends to pay my bills. Today, my job is serving Nevada in the U.S. Senate, and it is the honor of my life. And I’m especially proud to represent the union members and hardworking families who built our great state. I will always remember my roots. That’s why I never let up in the fight to grow our middle class, create good-paying jobs, and lower everyday costs. body:
Peter, did you see our email about the direction of the U.S. Supreme Court?

Right now, the Supreme Court is weighing critical questions about the First Amendment, medical care for transgender teens, and a pivotal case regarding racial gerrymandering.

This gerrymandering case will play a massive roll in protecting (or rolling back) voting rights. _**And with the current state of the Supreme Court, we’re really worried about the future of this critical issue.**_

As Emerge continues our work to empower Democratic women to fight for our rights in every state, we count on input from supporters like you. _But I noticed your response is still missing._

**Please, can you respond to our live poll now? We're hoping to reach 100 responses by midnight, and you can help get us 1% of the way there.**

Peter, it's been long over a year since the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_ – stripping away reproductive freedom from millions of Americans.
But, in the time since, we've seen one disastrous decision after another. This ultraconservative majority – stacked with justices appointed by Donald Trump – has handed down rulings that attack LGBTQ+ rights, affirmative action, student loan forgiveness, and so much more. Now, the Court is set to hear arguments in a racial gerrymandering challenge to one of Southern Carolina's Republican-controlled districts.
**This much is clear: The direction of the current Supreme Court is far from the will of the American people.**
In this urgent moment, our mission to get more fierce Democratic women in office who will defend our fundamental rights and safeguard the future of our democracy is as important as ever. That’s why we launched our Gavel In training this year – to train jurists who want to serve in judgeships to run successful and strategic political campaigns. But it's going to take all of us fighting together, side by side.
**That's why we're counting on 53 more Emerge community members – including you – to take a stand alongside us today. So please, before our live poll closes at midnight, tell us: **
**Do you approve of the current Supreme Court?**

The radical Left is EVISCERATING President Trump's First Amendment rights. They indicted him. They arrested him. Now they're trying to stop him from defending himself. Here's their disgraceful track record of violating his right to freedom of speech:
1. The radical Left petitioned for a gag order...

name: Ro Khanna
subject: We need to ban assault weapons
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Eighteen people lost their lives last Wednesday when a lone gunman suffering from mental illness, armed with an AR-15 and extensive military training, attacked a bowling alley and a nearby bar and grill in Lewiston, Maine. The victims, enjoying a night out with a youth bowling league and a cornhole tournament, on a typical weeknight in a quiet community never came home. My heart is with the families and friends who lost their loved ones in this senseless act of violence.

The tragedy in Maine marks the 565th mass shooting in the US in 2023 alone. That’s nearly two mass shootings per day. What’s painfully true is that this tragedy and so many others could have been avoided if Congress would enact simple gun safety standards.

Tell Congress: Ban assault rifles and high-capacity magazines. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/gun-reform-petition?contactdata=wKzqzm3KHYMqQfJOvVjHK2NiF5GGK/grWyGhdrUbHkdef5xyPH8TP5NM5guOO0TAjT/b/fqs7TBLTXNoghJN2i8d/7ZNKh7b2Z1IME9mMua9aaQIgmMx2snIMIFO1Mj7jm7pM4laf7jwgtOAJwIJPw==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/gun-reform-petition?contactdata=wKzqzm3KHYMqQfJOvVjHK2NiF5GGK/grWyGhdrUbHkdef5xyPH8TP5NM5guOO0TAjT/b/fqs7TBLTXNoghJN2i8d/7ZNKh7b2Z1IME9mMua9aaQIgmMx2snIMIFO1Mj7jm7pM4laf7jwgtOAJwIJPw==]

We can’t afford to let the status quo continue. Americans deserve to live their lives free of fear and violence.

In solidarity,
Ro

He’s committed to defending American liberty, reducing out-of-control spending, and securing the border. I was proud to support him for Speaker of the House. House Republicans are united behind Speaker Johnson and eager to begin enacting policies that will help hard-working Americans. But Democrats fear a unified Republican Conference standing behind a principled conservative. They know our ideas are popular with the American people. That’s why they’re attacking me for supporting Speaker Johnson. Dark money groups have already spent $1.2 million in attack ads against me this year. Now, they’re spending thousands of dollars attacking me for supporting Speaker Johnson. Mike Johnson is not an extremist. He’s a principled conservative who attends church and believes in limited government. But this is what National Democrats consider “extreme.” House Republicans currently have a 4-seat majority. It’s one of the smallest majorities in American history. If we want to keep our majority in 2024, we must win Wisconsin’s First Congressional District. I need your help to fight back. Thank you, Rep. Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn't even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last week - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people's House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I've sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

clean_body: It's imperative you read this as soon as you see it. | Fellow American, It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn't even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House. My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last week - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people's House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS. In the past week, 1. I've sifted through hundreds of resumes. 2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch. 3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. I've got to be honest with you - with so many competing priorities, I'm working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol. You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year's election. If we come up short, all bets are off. I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we've made toward hitting this critical campaign goal. Let's get this done. For America, Mike Johnson Speaker of the House | MIKE JOHNSON * Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana. | PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA Freedom Nation Today 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 | _

| _“Collecting more taxes than is absolutely necessary is legalized robbery.”_ -Calvin Coolidge

The increasing property assessments and notices of increasing tax levies across many Nebraska counties are weighing heavy on Nebraska residents and with good reason!

We pay sales tax on what we CHOOSE to buy.
We pay income tax ideally on a job we CHOOSE to work for.

But as taxpayers, we have NO CHOICE in the ASSESSMENT value of our property AND the MULTIPLIER of the tax levy from dozens of taxing authorities. Taxing of the citizens has reached epic proportions and we need solutions.

With the focus of our next NEGOP Roundtable Discussion revolving around continued tax reform, [**we want to invite you to submit questions for our panel hosts.**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ea565eb067&e=25844e23a8)

| | | The thought of Trump in the White House again is terrifying – it would spell the end of our democracy. And even though he's under investigation for several of his crimes and facing dozens of federal counts, he's still the Republican 2024 frontrunner. **[But the 14th Amendment should disqualify Trump from running again, because of his involvement in the January 6th insurrection.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7d65ecb8-4a90-4f10-ba86-f1d55a3dbd2e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** See Section 3 of the 14th Amendment: _" No person shall be a Senator or Representative in Congress... or hold any office...who, having previously taken an oath...to support the Constitution of the United States, shall have engaged in insurrection or rebellion against the [Constitution]."_ And this could happen – hearings have just begun in Colorado and Minnesota to determine whether those states will do it. The Supreme Court will likely have to make the final decision, but it's important that these states first decide that Trump is ineligible to be on the ballot. Yes, it would be unprecedented, but remember that this is the man who sent a violent mob to attack Congress – something unprecedented as well. Trump has more than earned this. [**Add your name to show your support: Trump must be disqualified from running for president! >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T617dd5f3-c780-4242-8537-917664df3dd0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

It doesn't get more political than this. Vos has no reason to impeach Wolfe but is doing so out of fear of being removed from office.
Just last month, Vos said in an interview that he would not take action on impeachment charges against Wolfe until the conclusion of a lawsuit filed against the GOP lawmakers who attempted to oust her. But that is no longer the case.
The worst part? All 15 impeachment articles against Wolfe contain misleading or false claims about how the elections administration works in Wisconsin.
The GOP attempting to impeach Wolfe is a direct consequence of them not getting their preferred outcome during elections.
**And if left in power, Republicans are going to stop at nothing to attack and undermine our democracy. They want to fan the flames of Trump's false claims that the election was stolen.**

Peter,
This Election Day, Gardner has the opportunity to re-elect a leader with a proven track record of success. Mayor Mike Nicholson is running for re-election and is running to keep Gardner moving forward.

✅ Invested in school music, sports, and art programs

subject: Schumer blocking Israel aid bill – Call your senators now

body:

---
Speaker Mike Johnson, who you helped become Speaker, has passed his first bill as Speaker though the House, and now we need to help it even get a vote in the Senate. The bill is the standalone aid package for Israel that is paid for by taking money away from the IRS that was going to be used to pay for more IRS agents. It doesn’t include other, nonrelated spending, and TWELVE Democrats voted for it too! However, over in the Senate, Chuck Schumer has stated he will ignore the standalone Israel bill, and allow it to have a vote. He will likely attach a full supplemental request (Israel-Ukraine-Taiwan-border money) to the Continuing Resolution in two weeks. _**Side note:** “border” money from Biden and the Democrats is actually more accurately described as “resettlement” money. They will claim the money will help with the border crisis, when in reality it will help facilitate the border crisis by funding the travel and resettlement of illegal immigrants into communities across the United States._ The timing of when Schumer will move this bill is unclear right now. But we need to launch the grassroots action now. When you call both of your Senators, you will want to talk to them about this bill and also ask them to defend Sen. Tommy Tuberville for his effort to stop the Biden military nominees who are woke Marxists from being confirmed, and to stop the military from paying travel costs for female service members who are stationed in states where abortion is illegal to travel to states where it is legal. [**Read the details about Sen. Tuberville’s efforts**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) and how some of the _Republicans in the Senate_ are joining with Democrats to attack him! It makes you wonder why these Republicans are siding with _Biden_ by accusing Sen. Tuberville of weakening our military as he blocks Marxists from leadership positions... Use the appropriate sample script provided, based on whether you have Republican or Democrat senators. We also want to amplify Speaker Johnson’s social media post as well. name: Connor Lounsbury
subject: Why I love working for Wes
body:
Hey there, I’m Connor from Team Wes.
I wanted to tell you a little bit about why I chose to join the Governor’s team, and why it’s one of the best decisions I’ve ever made.
Back in 2022, when Wes was running, a few things stood out to me:
***Wes is a lifelong patriot who has actually put his life on the line for his country, and refused to let Republicans who supported the insurrection claim the term “patriotism” for themselves
***Wes didn’t just seek out friendly audiences on the trail. He was determined to talk to everyone, and not count anyone out
***He was one of the most effective, inspiring messengers I’d ever seen!
So I joined the team — and I’ve never looked back.
To be honest, I didn’t think anything could top how amazing it felt when Wes won his race last November — with the widest margin of any Democratic governor in the country, and as the first Black governor in the history of Maryland. “Governor-elect” quickly became one of my favorite words!
But really, the true joy of this work has been watching Wes bring his campaign promises to life for Marylanders, one after the next.
Take service for example. On the trail, Wes spoke a lot about how service is sticky and brings people together. "Those who serve together stay together."
And now as Governor, he's created that life-changing opportunity for young Marylanders with a first-in-the-nation service year option for high school graduates. I hate to sound sentimental, but it's inspiring stuff.
In an issue very close to my heart, it’s also been special to watch Wes fulfill his promises to stand with and uplift Maryland LGBTQIA+ community — from proclaiming the state’s first Transgender Day of Visibility to signing protections for gender-affirming care into law.
In a time of jaded politics, Wes refuses to fall prey to the usual BS. Instead, he’s out here bringing communities together and making Maryland into a state that will lead the way for the rest of the nation.
He awakens the best in people. That includes me.
Okay, before I get too cheesy, I’m going to wrap up with a simple request. If you can’t spare a donation today, don’t worry — Wes and our whole team are just glad you’re with us. But if you CAN chip in a few bucks, I really can’t think of any public servant who is more inspiring and deserving of our support.
Make a contribution today to support Wes Moore’s leadership in Maryland. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231103-1?refcode=em20231103]
Donate » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231103-1?refcode=em20231103]
Thanks for everything, and I hope you have a beautiful weekend!
—Connor

Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00ef3322b48c4aac831f3ccd1003ab85&_e=u_1hHFzo5Mgall5RWxw_C7par1w6WuZ0g7a2Y1g85UtuxGxT7AfJ8Vl5wNI7jJae_vOMCrw449kbUxhp_HCoCfCoKj1bjYHdeDSK7n5FN-BrOi6zHGuPUE0yNwikswTeRJNybJl6BfbBAXp5P2_-bD9npVIEiRBnUh3fxuvZUPH6G11tco-JWLecxxhEau3dfrk2lWaY0ISQrUPVzsTxWRTWzZLkPPgRfy0tAg1gU2AU05fJnRDDFThIt2FxTaNOyP56l3aoo7W0oEehp2iFZUXgpm9GDSRdezukpQPAq8FvJkZZDn3Fjj1BRSqYRNA6XubIG5_SCkuxBiTYs25SkZPDLunDTyidVz9mDlY69xllxeVQYs-1-f4sMFzRlgaU9RCq_v98qKXBOACIRkqnZQ%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00ef3322b48c4aac831f3ccd1003ab85&_e=u_1hHFzo5Mgall5RWxw_C7par1w6WuZ0g7a2Y1g85UtuxGxT7AfJ8Vl5wNI7jJae_vOMCrw449kbUxhp_HCoCfCoKj1bjYHdeDSK7n5FN-BrOi6zHGuPUE0yNwikswTeRJNybJl6BfbBAXp5P2_-bD9npVIEiRBnUh3fxuvZUPH6G11tco-JWLecxxhEau3dfrk2lWaY0ISQrUPVzsTxWRTWzZLkPPgRfy0tAg1gU2AU05fJnRDDFThIt2FxTaNOabywhwFRKLbOKoPB0cJfQkwiz5RJlTc7JbrT9HtGDbt04yF9YPAeZyM2uoENuEvkYVOoi9sJCFiu7ky2aUhEeTXBz1bYq0ODTSfAMm6XDHpoMkgEKZiZavoXXIwV9-p4yMRn_jgj9oXtUVXz6rsUZQ%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff have told me that we’re just short of having raised $1 million online since I was elected speaker last week. In fact, we have just another $134,000 to raise to hit that mark – and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=00ef3322b48c4aac831f3ccd1003ab85&_e=u_1hHFzo5Mgall5RWxw_C7par1w6WuZ0g7a2Y1g85UtuxGxT7AfJ8Vl5wNI7jJae_vOMCrw449kbUxhp_HCoCfCoKj1bjYHdeDSK7n5FN-BrOi6zHGuPUE0yNwikswTeRJNybJl6BfbBAXp5P2_-bD9npVIEiRBnUh3fxuvZUPH6G11tco-JWLecxxhEau3dfrk2lWaY0ISQrUPVzsTxWRTWzZLkPPgRfy0tAg1gU2AU05fJnRDDFThIt2FxTaNO8Czvrqr6f7qztR1JmzsCxaLwnoYXTjHM97d5U2Bg2zeqARu5w7X0Y32kKMhQV9m9kf1SWscCpuFFqf2sCcx0TjnKXMFW3S3PhpSMCwI2-uoReiz95D19ODhpBXXxZPLy3qbM8kMCHH3hoYicDOUuzw%3D%3D)

clean_body: I’m trying to send a very strong message to Democrats. I’ll need your help to make sure they get it. | | Fellow American, It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House. My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS. In the past week, 1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes. 2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch. 3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol. You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election. If we come up short, all bets are off. I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we’ve made toward hitting this critical campaign goal. Let’s get this done. subject: AOC vs. AIPAC
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As Israel continues to carry out collective punishment and relentlessly
bomb Gaza, AIPAC is attacking progressive Democrats like AOC, Rashida
Tlaib, Jamaal Bowman, Ilhan Omar, and Summer Lee for demanding a
ceasefire.

But AOC is fighting back and calling AIPAC out:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231103.OQMfD5&refcode=em20231103-31662&t=1001&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Tweet from AOC: AIPAC endorsed scores of Jan 6th insurrectionists. They
are no friend to American democracy. They are one of the more racist and
bigoted PACs in Congress as well, who disproportionately target members of
color. They are an extremist organization that destabilizes US democracy.

Here at Justice Democrats, we’ve been sounding the alarm around AIPAC and
its dangerous influence on politics and the fabric of our democracy since
we were founded.

For years, AIPAC has spent millions against our movement and our
candidates. We need to be prepared for them to spend big against us again.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231103.OQMfD5&refcode=em20231103-31662&amount=3&t=1002&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Will you contribute $3 right now help us fight back?

This right-wing group funded by GOP billionaires will attack any and every
candidate who stands up for the human rights of Palestinians, even
Democratic incumbents. They spent millions against progressives in past
elections and are now actively recruiting candidates to challenge the
Squad in 2024.

Not only that, but like AOC mentioned, AIPAC endorsed 109 Republicans who
supported the January 6 insurrection. They’re not looking out for
democracy, just their corporate and pro-Israel interests.

We won’t let AIPAC succeed in pushing our progressive champions out of
office next year, but to go up against them and their super PACs, we need
the help of grassroots supporters like you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231103.OQMfD5&refcode=em20231103-31662&amount=3&t=1003&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Please, if you can, pitch in $3 today to fuel Justice
Democrats’ work to re-elect the Squad and fight back against AIPAC’s war
chest →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231103.OQMfD5&refcode=em20231103-31662&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Contribute $3

AIPAC would love if Justice Democrats and the Squad would stay silent on
the sidelines, but we will always use our collective power to stand up for
human rights.

Thank you for all you do to support us,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1023&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1024&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231103-31662-footer&t=1025&refcode2=31662_1203867_bDfJci&akid=31662%2E1203867%2EbDfJci

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. | | Peter, The Leftist organization Elias Law Group is planning legal action that could destroy the integrity of our elections...

The Elias Law Group, which is focused on "electing Democrats, supporting voting rights, and helping progressives make change," is filing a lawsuit to take down one of Wisconsin's last remaining election security measures.

**If successful, absentee voters in Wisconsin would no longer need a witness to certify they signed their ballot and sealed their envelope. **

This would completely erode the small amount of integrity that remains with absentee voting, and it's particularly threatening to America's most vulnerable populations.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=debf073fabd2445f9639856e8d726eb2&_e=3OtcE8Ek5fkMKnxUV4MXwsqVKfZ6-uVM3Fqny1i4tudwyU8sykQBLUgOyEamQ0cgZ4aMvtFDQmts7Xo73AXHaODaVbg6734c_NvBNuhkON51FtxO0yCki_xWEOF4L6IXj0LzQDxZrsAIs_s-Gs9uKWZar4JIEldumuWz5xu1qyZBICkjWW5hhxCz-T6_lYJBGmNEBl5leqUjPqVDIRME8vmmNRDrUzZltgDnMTBNjwVOAYj0izJL9mr91cjBSYyo-pa46Bmng2RxBd8oi26gK0KJdxmrlskAcapLaxvEhAqQYQCihud9Q_pJ8HFRP8sYachwYoFZFKTXL0QyrHrPxUyF378vJHm8S2AlaZ0MxFEu5JE5eOYiWe5jBz9xYvhK)

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Peter,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6983ac67ce9d453c95afb8433931c6a1&_e=lA8U001GveQLBri6X9hB7tG-_e6oiOfU82W75-lYl2WqjwQauX9qr4l9s9_fSqoHxfPU_XCTndFhNhTJgOppeXu_9JW5D0JV_ZMFpxgfnIpHRuJWDCt4rWgDNlKT4fHqwSydloPD6GdauV0QkhXmW4a0vMFp-Y72HvTuitDjJpNIAGFoYLK49kaa1jJ6-QD9r53Q5195boZYcPQ6mIymeDdawgeXw-zcw0ZGCM2gYTZ76EQCIv3SCP_i-WM25xiLLher8j23QtwV9m4B6BFmIgjIaTx2N_a7svR2u5PAFaOE6OVVwlYnGBHZiCUGoJMlBSzJJO3qo4FJg1l0U6vYElZgzES4-SPeM95Lc9ihhqDtFROVb1x9B8WhO2mJtlPWlBFR_qgbeYQFYrHnUfFkRA%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6983ac67ce9d453c95afb8433931c6a1&_e=lA8U001GveQLBri6X9hB7tG-_e6oiOfU82W75-lYl2WqjwQauX9qr4l9s9_fSqoHxfPU_XCTndFhNhTJgOppeXu_9JW5D0JV_ZMFpxgfnIpHRuJWDCt4rWgDNlKT4fHqwSydloPD6GdauV0QkhXmW4a0vMFp-Y72HvTuitDjJpNIAGFoYLK49kaa1jJ6-QD9r53Q5195boZYcPQ6mIymeDdawgeXw-zcw0ZGCM2gYTZLH4DYAaJPZ4PmRiWlB4USO1tI3J3Kaew-qeBSOm1Oku3s1c9pPnnTF6vuGRFB0V0sHZu74Gwz7TJ5gT2q_JeG8L26gttSheZkbVfpUt11qwywVhdJYu5w-hO_NwrnAZHHkYoJVniOlKfRo__z9037gcABU_3U0wJbL9lHF2G8Kg%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff have told me that we’re just short of having raised $1 million online since I was elected speaker last week. In fact, we have just another $134,000 to raise to hit that mark – and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6983ac67ce9d453c95afb8433931c6a1&_e=lA8U001GveQLBri6X9hB7tG-_e6oiOfU82W75-lYl2WqjwQauX9qr4l9s9_fSqoHxfPU_XCTndFhNhTJgOppeXu_9JW5D0JV_ZMFpxgfnIpHRuJWDCt4rWgDNlKT4fHqwSydloPD6GdauV0QkhXmW4a0vMFp-Y72HvTuitDjJpNIAGFoYLK49kaa1jJ6-QD9r53Q5195boZYcPQ6mIymeDdawgeXw-zcw0ZGCM2gYTaEpVn7HNyjWiF6j5azaLGXz76MkH0piQpl2qjFrmoTZB19K0Mftl2Z-SGw74VTezh84WAumnXS6vPAuSzt6aU-wR7dCTWj0OVz-67eLt1X0GuhbP1tygTDTAcUzQNTnJuaN3C57dPsR3LvfPFLQNKcK6cJ3P6mvLNZB1NxpKQmsA%3D%3D)

clean_body: It’s imperative you read this as soon as you see it. | | Peter, It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House. My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS. In the past week, 1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes. 2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch. 3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol. You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election. If we come up short, all bets are off. I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we’ve made toward hitting this critical campaign goal. Let’s get this done. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I’m writing to thank everyone for such generous support in October. During a time of so much chaos and uncertainty in Washington and around the world, it means so much to know this team remains engaged in our efforts for 2024.
We’ve seen plenty of reminders this past month on why our work together is vital. We start this month with a new Speaker of the House and a new urgency to our work. We’ve spent almost a full year with House Republicans in the majority. We’ve seen their priorities, their policies, and their politics. And we’ve seen their inability to govern.

| Peter,

Valerie here. I want to provide a quick update on voting rights here in North Carolina.

North Carolina is a key battleground state for the 2024 elections. **That also means it’s a battleground state for the GOP’s attacks on voting rights.** North Carolina’s GOP supermajority is clearing the way for _partisan gerrymandering, discriminatory voter ID laws, cuts to early voting, and reducing ballot access by eliminating mail-in ballots._

**Ensuring equal access to the ballot should be our #1 priority. **I commend the Democratic party in North Carolina for challenging the GOP's assault on voting rights. In Congress, I’m working tirelessly to do the same.

I’m proud to have co-sponsored the _Freedom to Vote Act_ and introduced the _Democracy Restoration Act_ to restore access to the ballot and protect our sacred right to vote. North Carolina is a key battleground state for the 2024 elections. That also means it’s a battleground state for the GOP’s attacks on voting rights. North Carolina’s GOP supermajority is clearing the way for partisan gerrymandering, discriminatory voter ID laws, cuts to early voting, and reducing ballot access by eliminating mail-in ballots. Ensuring equal access to the ballot should be our #1 priority. I commend the Democratic party in North Carolina for challenging the GOP's assault on voting rights. In Congress, I’m working tirelessly to do the same. I’m proud to have co-sponsored the Freedom to Vote Act and introduced the Democracy Restoration Act to restore access to the ballot and protect our sacred right to vote. MEET RYAN

* * *
_When it comes to fighting for American freedoms and helping others, Ryan Mackenzie has had some great teachers.

A 9th generation resident of the Lehigh Valley, Ryan's first ancestor to settle in our area fought in the Northampton County Militia during the Revolutionary War. In more recent generations, his family members helped build companies like Hercules Cement, served our country in both World Wars, and served our community here at home in professions like nursing and teaching.

It's that spirit of service that inspired Ryan to fight back against the Far Left here in Pennsylvania. Ryan faced an all-out assault by the abortion industry in his first race, and he beat them back. Rush Limbaugh said of Ryan: "Planned Parenthood took it on the chin ... Mackenzie won by an 18-point margin."

In Pennsylvania's state capitol, Ryan is known by conservatives and feared by the establishment as one of the most effective and proven reformers in government. Ryan didn't just talk – he got our values enacted into law._

Friend,

It’s Governor Glenn Youngkin asking for your help in the final stretch of this critical election.

Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, the DNC, and many non-Virginia Democrats have made our elections a top priority. They’ve poured millions upon millions of dollars into our Commonwealth to sell blatant lies and spread fear.

But we know that hope beats fear every day of the week.

That’s why we continue to focus our message on **hope**.

**Hope** for a brighter future for all Virginians.

**Hope** for parents who should be exclusively in charge of their children’s lives.

**Hope** for every Virginia student who deserves a chance at success with a best-in-class education.

**Hope** for hardworking families who want to keep more of the money they’ve earned rather than see it stolen by inflation or high taxes.

**Hope** for those struggling with behavioral health challenges that they will get the right help right now.

**Hope** for communities that want to feel safer with law enforcement that is supported and funded.

**_And an eye toward allowing Virginia’s priorities and successes to provide a blueprint for the nation._**

This is the choice in this election: hope vs. fear; leading vs. lying; coming together vs. driving apart.

And with your help, we will have the resources we need to make sure we communicate with every Virginian in the closing days of this election.

Please contribute anything you can as we work to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

clean_body: Help Us WIN | Friend, It’s Governor Glenn Youngkin asking for your help in the final stretch of this critical election. Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, the DNC, and many non-Virginia Democrats have made our elections a top priority. They’ve poured millions upon millions of dollars into our Commonwealth to sell blatant lies and spread fear. But we know that hope beats fear every day of the week. That’s why we continue to focus our message on hope. Hope for a brighter future for all Virginians. Hope for parents who should be exclusively in charge of their children’s lives. Hope for every Virginia student who deserves a chance at success with a best-in-class education. Hope for hardworking families who want to keep more of the money they’ve earned rather than see it stolen by inflation or high taxes. Hope for those struggling with behavioral health challenges that they will get the right help right now. Hope for communities that want to feel safer with law enforcement that is supported and funded. And an eye toward allowing Virginia’s priorities and successes to provide a blueprint for the nation. This is the choice in this election: hope vs. fear; leading vs. lying; coming together vs. driving apart. And with your help, we will have the resources we need to make sure we communicate with every Virginian in the closing days of this election. Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past week,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ad6280b4dd764ba1a06a651246af47f1&_e=WA8QyzLCAuqYU6_dXpa1Qn7oaCZDl8ACWWs6DPv2rEJ4hNMXKwtnbECWpgqZZHdDkyNyy6y1yQECFbk4HQu8bGEPN3QzZuX-nvTSGaoeVvispHA1AELznkRqklEe8DB0ae-Pvwzw_XRWuOBZLPg7eZmD50U5o6PwF98g2Zc7I40yBeo-WnvHBeppNShZMKCvQJLVXhn05clNrbt7-_mQ6aZpauVjMlKAVwMo4f0NxwpOFSnE87XXVoGnfRiferYpjdqELenU7g1T9_YZFsMvpxFuIyWMec9B9c3nahChCKXr3Xf7JekihvQKiOV3ph_zjzJL15Tqy75OTg7gf6bHSk_VXTzcJwvuUuiGMIikEX9SdZ93vzPagaTHXOGA7izVqYZsZJxy0pC4J8Y9l9OGJg%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ad6280b4dd764ba1a06a651246af47f1&_e=WA8QyzLCAuqYU6_dXpa1Qn7oaCZDl8ACWWs6DPv2rEJ4hNMXKwtnbECWpgqZZHdDkyNyy6y1yQECFbk4HQu8bGEPN3QzZuX-nvTSGaoeVvispHA1AELznkRqklEe8DB0ae-Pvwzw_XRWuOBZLPg7eZmD50U5o6PwF98g2Zc7I40yBeo-WnvHBeppNShZMKCvQJLVXhn05clNrbt7-_mQ6aZpauVjMlKAVwMo4f0NxwrwF7CWzPYWsgR3KEnknts5FN0-mfk6K3nUYSSC4anVIPNa-Qu_wFbiUuMVX0fvtec0s-MpK0KRCbWmOEVLS7qn0k37esOa6YQKezAmgCHe6hRfUo3zDcwmjFAJM6YAzmefFz2EWf5O2vgckTWid215-wfRF43OUKr9F_iivvWZwg%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff have told me that we’re just short of having raised $1 million online since I was elected speaker last week. In fact, we have just another $134,000 to raise to hit that mark – and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ad6280b4dd764ba1a06a651246af47f1&_e=WA8QyzLCAuqYU6_dXpa1Qn7oaCZDl8ACWWs6DPv2rEJ4hNMXKwtnbECWpgqZZHdDkyNyy6y1yQECFbk4HQu8bGEPN3QzZuX-nvTSGaoeVvispHA1AELznkRqklEe8DB0ae-Pvwzw_XRWuOBZLPg7eZmD50U5o6PwF98g2Zc7I40yBeo-WnvHBeppNShZMKCvQJLVXhn05clNrbt7-_mQ6aZpauVjMlKAVwMo4f0NxwpahFXUB0ebLZxUIpZsi8I5kncRwV8Dz_ZeicMsOj1sd2iI6l6iPgWr5tmfDepAZRMmlE7N9nN0Hchj1ab_MVS6Q8gf0Up3aLbndN3i8zE39JRkkrD-whUvef6A2yh1_Nk1h30SbuwxwYf_paOPH6-9uS2RSkym_DINgsm3FoO7Ww%3D%3D)

clean_body: I’m trying to send a very strong message to Democrats. I’ll need your help to make sure they get it. | | Fellow American, It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last ten days have been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House. My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last week – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS. In the past week, 1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes. 2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch. 3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others. 4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year. I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol. You see, aside from my official duties as speaker, That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election. If we come up short, all bets are off. I have to get back to interviewing candidates to join my team, but I'll be checking in with my staff frequently over the next few days to see what progress we’ve made toward hitting this critical campaign goal. Let’s get this done. | | Peter, After nearly a month of self-inflicted gridlock, the House of Representatives was finally able to get back to work earlier this week. This news _should_ be some much-needed relief — but now Congress is facing another potential government shutdown if they can't pass a spending bill in the next two weeks. I'm sure I can guess your reaction here: **_Again?_** Yes, it feels like we've all been watching our government get pushed to the brink of another shutdown for months. But while most headlines focus on the latest outrageous nonsense coming out of Congress, **I'm thinking about the real damage to our district that we face with these constant spending fights.** I'm thinking about the next class of high school graduates in our district, who may be unable to continue their studies and pursue their passions because funding for Pell Grants might get cut. I'm thinking of the young adults working to build a life for themselves in Los Angeles, but who struggle to find opportunities because people in Congress want to slash funding for job trainings, apprenticeship programs, and housing vouchers. I'm thinking about the parents I represent on the school board, who should feel secure in taking care of their families — but instead could be forced to stretch every dollar in their budget, because funding for childcare, Head Start, and WIC benefits wound up on the chopping block in this spending fight. And I'm thinking of the seniors in CA-30, who could find the rug pulled out from under them because people in Congress want to cut funding for Meals on Wheels and local Social Security field offices. **_None of this is a game_**. If the House GOP has its way, our district will suffer real consequences. All of the families, seniors, and workers in CA-30 whose lives are impacted by the decisions in Washington deserve a representative who will keep our communities supported. **That doesn't happen with partisan soundbites or grandstanding, but with serious leadership focused on results.** That's what our movement is fighting for, and that's the leadership I'll bring to Congress as our next representative. clean_body: Who I’ve been thinking about lately in these spending fights. | | | | Peter, After nearly a month of self-inflicted gridlock, the House of Representatives was finally able to get back to work earlier this week. This news should be some much-needed relief — but now Congress is facing another potential government shutdown if they can't pass a spending bill in the next two weeks. I'm sure I can guess your reaction here: Again? Yes, it feels like we've all been watching our government get pushed to the brink of another shutdown for months. But while most headlines focus on the latest outrageous nonsense coming out of Congress, I'm thinking about the real damage to our district that we face with these constant spending fights. I'm thinking about the next class of high school graduates in our district, who may be unable to continue their studies and pursue their passions because funding for Pell Grants might get cut. I'm thinking of the young adults working to build a life for themselves in Los Angeles, but who struggle to find opportunities because people in Congress want to slash funding for job trainings, apprenticeship programs, and housing vouchers. I'm thinking about the parents I represent on the school board, who should feel secure in taking care of their families — but instead could be forced to stretch every dollar in their budget, because funding for childcare, Head Start, and WIC benefits wound up on the chopping block in this spending fight. And I'm thinking of the seniors in CA-30, who could find the rug pulled out from under them because people in Congress want to cut funding for Meals on Wheels and local Social Security field offices. None of this is a game. If the House GOP has its way, our district will suffer real consequences. All of the families, seniors, and workers in CA-30 whose lives are impacted by the decisions in Washington deserve a representative who will keep our communities supported. That doesn't happen with partisan soundbites or grandstanding, but with serious leadership focused on results. That's what our movement is fighting for, and that's the leadership I'll bring to Congress as our next representative. = More soon, Nick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Nick Melvoin for Congress - FEC ID #C00831289 |

WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh shares his weekly video updates with WA Republicans.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Friend, Like many before him, the mass murderer who used an AR-15 to slaughter over 18 innocent people in Maine was radicalized by far-right disinformation and extremist content. The shooter’s engagement with fringe extremist content on social media included a troubling trail of interactions with accounts known for spreading hate and dangerous, violent rhetoric—**and many Republican politicians, such as my opponent Jim Jordan, featured very prominently on that list:**
---
---
_The Maine shooter had a Twitter account and he visited Jim Jordan's Twitter page numerous times before taking fire upon innocent civilians. The above screenshot come from the leaked Twitter history of the shooter's account before it was taken offline._
---
Jim Jordan’s extremist and hateful content was, and is, a huge part of the digital ecosystem that the mass murderer in Maine interacted with on a frequent basis. Seeing his interaction with Jordan’s content and far-right rhetoric provides a glimpse into some of the factors that drove him to his violent act. Callous politicians like Jim Jordan think they can say whatever they want and be completely immune from the consequences of their speech. We can’t lay the blame for an individual’s actions fully at Jordan’s feet, but we can call out his role as an influential public figure who frequently stokes baseless outrage against “leftists,” immigrants, Democrats, so-called “Never Trumpers”—anyone he disagrees with. **We need to get back to the days when our leaders brought out the best in us, not the worst!** I will call him out every time he stoles his hate speech, and I will beat him this election, I will defeat Jim Jordan. **[Will you stand with me against Jordan and Trump’s dangerous violent rhetoric and help me shut Jordan up? Peter,

The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. body:

---
Dear Friend, In case you missed yesterday's message from our board member David Guttenberg, the [Build Alaska’s Future](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72744284/436266145/-1512324198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjI0N2NiMS03ZTdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HWmc9J4O4CXi06YCGVqhrJKC6G-N8mxHhd77K2HCTk0=&emci=5ba95fc4-6e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=02247cb1-7e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399) (BAF) team recently unveiled an exciting interactive GIS map. We invite you to tune into a webinar on Monday, November 6 at 4pm AKST where you can learn more about using this innovative resource. Register for the webinar [here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72744286/436266149/1198355120?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjI0N2NiMS03ZTdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HWmc9J4O4CXi06YCGVqhrJKC6G-N8mxHhd77K2HCTk0=&emci=5ba95fc4-6e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=02247cb1-7e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399). This map is a groundbreaking tool providing unprecedented access to federal funding data and transformative insights into proposed infrastructure projects state-wide. The first and only of its kind, it is a powerful resource for Alaska citizens, academics, and policymakers alike to interpret federal spending, empower data-driven decision-making, and help launch our state into the future. From highway upgrades to high-speed broadband, airports to waterworks, every Alaskan deserves to know what’s going on in their great backyard. Every Alaskan deserves the opportunity to engage directly with infrastructure development, interpret the available data, and have a say in funding allocation. to learn more about using this innovative resource. No one knows Alaska better than Alaskans and we are entitled to know what’s on the table, what our communities are set to gain, and how to potentiate the billions of federal dollars pouring into the state from Washington, D.C. Together, we can elevate Alaskans’ voices, build sustainable economic growth, support infrastructure project visibility, and promote a healthy environment. **Mapping a Path to s Stronger Alaska Webinar:** Date: Monday, November 6thTime: 4:00pm AKST Registration: [https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZUkduyvqjwoEte7qTzTo_H_0abBTQfpW1Oo](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72744287/436266152/1198355120?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjI0N2NiMS03ZTdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HWmc9J4O4CXi06YCGVqhrJKC6G-N8mxHhd77K2HCTk0=&emci=5ba95fc4-6e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=02247cb1-7e7a-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399) We hope to see you on Monday! Sincerely, The Build Alaska's Future Team

| Peter,

Last week’s mass shooting in Lewiston, Maine, was a chilling reminder of the reality our country is facing.

Right now, our country is facing a gun violence epidemic, and we need to enact significant reforms to stop this epidemic and put an end to mass shootings.

**I’ve proudly supported gun safety reform during my time in Congress, and I think it’s about time we take action to pass an assault weapons ban.**

These weapons of war have no place in our streets, in grocery stores, in our schools, or in movie theaters.

Assault weapons have been used in almost all of the last several deadly mass shootings in this country, and luckily, we have a way to stop this.

Congress passed an assault weapons ban in 1994, and we can do it again. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: I was in the hospital for three months
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. |
#
Hi there, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. **When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. **Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.** Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help. **[So today, I’m humbly asking: Will you split a donation between my reelection campaign and Tina Smith to defend our Senate majority and prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we’ve made expanding access to affordable health care?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72753946/436279021/-83437346?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20231103_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmVjY2MwNS04ODdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MyJJmBJpy7djMKa_Bjtz2xoaXnyvKJjrMHsHoKANpA0=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Tammy Baldwin and Tina Smith will go through immediately:_ | | [SPLIT $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72753947/436279022/-83437346?express_lane=true&amount=10&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20231103_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmVjY2MwNS04ODdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MyJJmBJpy7djMKa_Bjtz2xoaXnyvKJjrMHsHoKANpA0=)

body:
We’re not where we need to be in order to reach our Election Day goal, and too much is at stake to fall short.
| Team,

With just **four days** left until Election Day, we wanted to keep you in the loop on a few other numbers we’re keeping our eyes on:
* **4.7 million:** The number of Ohio families who could lose access to the full range of reproductive care if Republicans succeed in defeating Issue 1 on Tuesday
* More than **2,400:** The number of volunteers hard at work around the state right now making sure that every voter knows to get out and vote on Tuesday – and what’s at stake
* And finally: **$9,723:** The amount we still need to raise before Election Day

**[The ultimate goal – Election Day – is now only a few days away, and we absolutely cannot afford to fall short. Please, rush $5 right now to make sure we have the resources to fully fund our get-out-the-vote efforts.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72754082/436279532/1219931254?refcode=odp_em_231103_2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2Y0MThiZi04ODdhLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LkVBY4Ulfr7zAwIL2vM4S8AZuzVFbeN4MY2pFCq6sNw=)**

Ohio Republicans and their dark-money allies are spending big to try to tear down Issue 1 and get their misleading ads in front of voters, because they know what we know: Ohio is a pro-choice state.

But we also knew they would do anything they could to win, and we’ve been fighting back since day 1 – it’s why we invested in organizing efforts in every corner of the state, and why we started that work the very minute the last elections were over. We knew we couldn’t afford to rest, and we were right.

**FEATURED ARTICLES**
**[Ranked-Choice Voting is the Monster Under the Bed of American Elections](https://link.email.thepricklypear.)**
| [ ](https://link.email.thepricklypear.)
---
Ranked-choice voting ‘is a scheme of the Left to disenfranchise voters and elect more Democrats,’ a new report found.

Democrats are using ranked-choice voting (RCV) to benefit their party and disenfranchise voters in elections across the country, a new report provided to The Federalist found.

Published by the Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA), the new analysis unearths how Democrats use the complexities associated with RCV to diminish confidence in elections among U.S. voters. Under RCV, often dubbed “rigged-choice voting” by its critics, voters rank candidates in order of preference. If no candidate receives more than 50 percent of first-choice votes in the first round of voting, the last-place finisher is eliminated, and his votes are reallocated to the voter’s second-choice candidate.
